evidence.reason: At the pinned tip the fixture still configures only user.email/user.name and then commits at line 94 without setting repository-local commit.gpgSign=false. A global commit.gpgSign=true therefore propagates into this temporary repository and can make the baseline commit fail if the fixture identity has no usable signing key, causing every DeployTests case to error in setUp. The small hermetic fix is to set commit.gpgSign=false locally before the first commit; this is an ordinary test-fixture correctness repair, not a new requirement.
